what: On hover the text blinks once over .32s (opacity .6 · blur 4px at 56%) and the arrow piece bounces in .7s, right 5px → 3px → rest — if the arrow is still bouncing it is not triggered again. Without an arrow, like menu text, only the blink
ease: Blink: cubic-bezier(.55,.085,.68,.53) → cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) · Bounce: cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) → cubic-bezier(.37,0,.63,1) → cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)

options.dist: Farthest distance the arrow travels (px), default 5 — from 11.4%
options.back: Distance (px) it pauses once while coming back, default 3 — at 22.9%
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text to blink — all together if several. With no text or arrow, the element itself blinks
